about_the_game:
Momentum Mod is a first-person platforming game built on Valve’s Source Engine that centralizes movement-oriented game modes from various games like Counter-Strike, Team Fortress, Half-Life, and Quake 3. Speed is quite literally the name of the game, with each game mode offering a unique style of play centered around one shared goal: go fast!

  • Surf

  • Bunny Hop

  • Rocket Jump

  • Sticky Jump

  • Accelerated Hop

  • Conc

  • Climb (KZ)

  • Defrag

Coming in the future:

  • Tricksurf

  • Parkour

For seasoned veterans, Momentum aims to be as close to 1:1 as possible with the existing game modes found on servers, only with added convenience features and improvements as seen below:

  • Single-player client - no multiplayer game server connection required (no latency, ever)!

  • Global leaderboards - for every map added!

  • Replays and analytics - for every run submitted!

  • Integrated map selector - easy browsing and one-click downloads for maps, all from in-game!

  • Lag-free multiplayer - one-click P2P multiplayer with Steam Lobbies!

  • Original entities - easier mapping and interesting new opportunities for all supported gamemodes!

For newer players, Momentum Mod aims to be the perfect entry point for those curious about the aforementioned game modes. Being a free-to-play platform means there’s absolutely no barrier to entry with learning any movement, so give it a try, and make sure to preserve your velocity!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any up to date desktop-oriented distro
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo P9000 / AMD FX 4000 (Requires SSE4.1 Support)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 745 / Radeon HD 7790 (Requires Vulkan 1.3)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
  • VR Support: N/A

short_description: Source movement speedrunning at its finest. Momentum Mod centralizes and improves upon various community movement game types from various Source games. Play user-created maps, climb the ranked leaderboards, and become a master of each movement discipline.
